attempts.rationale: ranking is unstable, so a robust weighted combination should help.
The series has unstable ranking (tau -0.185) and strong seasonality; a robust median over all models may outperform a weighted combo.
test a robust weighted inverse-error combo on the full pool to see if weighting improves over median given unstable ranking.
Try a trimmed mean on the full pool to see if removing extremes improves robustness given unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
test a robust weighted combo with softmax_neg_error on the full pool to see if a sharper weighting outperforms median given unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking (tau -0.185) and strong seasonality; a robust DBA over the full pool may outperform the median.
test a simple mean over the full pool to see if a non‑robust but low‑variance combiner beats the current median leader.
Use a per‑horizon weighted combination that averages only the top‑few models at each step to capture horizon‑specific strengths (horizon‑based strategy).
test a robust weighted combo on the smaller, more stable pool4 using softmax_neg_error to see if less noisy weights help over median.
Test a robust median over the reduced, correlation‑aware pool4 to see if trimming correlated models improves over the full‑pool median.
The ranking is unstable and models cluster into distinct groups; a per‑horizon weighted top‑k may capture different strengths over the 13‑step horizon.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9902. Series context: trend strength 0.7865 and seasonal strength 0.9834; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.305.
